content:
marie: Saw a customer run into bad UX: onboarding sampleapp prefetch consumed most of demo account quota so interactive searches got 500ms+ p99s. Not just 429s it's starvation.

noah: Oof. Prefetch should be best-effort and never steal budget from interactive calls. Which SDK/version?

marie: JS SDK v0.28.0 with default prefetchWindow=4, no client-side throttling enabled. Customer had a tiny monthly free tier.

izzy: Do we have logs? curious if prefetch requests are indistinguishable from user requests to the rate limiter.

marie: Logs: 
```
incoming user req: id=U-32 start
prefetch request: id=P-11 start
prefetch request: id=P-12 start
quota: remaining=3
prefetch P-11 success
prefetch P-12 success
prefetch P-13 start -> consumes remaining quota
user req U-32 delayed waiting on connection pool
user req U-32 queued behind prefetch
```

owen: Yikes. Two problems: prefetch and user share the same token bucket and prefetch has no priority. Also no preemption to free inflight for an urgent user request.

noah: Proposed fixes: (1) implement weighted token buckets in client: reserve N tokens for interactive (or a fraction), (2) make prefetch use opportunistic tokens only after interactive reserve satisfied, (3) add prefetch preemption: if an interactive request arrives and inflight prefetch > M, cancel the oldest low-priority prefetch.

izzy: + expose config: `client.quota.interactiveReservePct`, `prefetch.priority=low`, `prefetch.preemptThreshold`. Defaults: reservePct=30, preemptThreshold=2.

marie: UX win in my local test: setting reservePct=40 kept p99 interactive latency <120ms even under heavy prefetch. Prefetch completion rate dropped but that's fine.

noah: Implementation notes: central HTTP transport needs to know request priority; token bucket should decrement by priority and block low-priority if reserve not met. Also we should surface a `X-Client-Priority` header for tracing and telemetry.

owen: For parity: JS/Go/Python must behave similarly. We'll keep default conservative and add an onboarding quickstart tip: "If your account quota is limited, set client.quota.interactiveReservePct to 30-50% to preserve interactive responsiveness."

izzy: Add telemetry metrics: `quota.interactive_reserve_ratio`, `prefetch.preempt_count`, `request.priority_wait_ms`. Alert if preempt_count > 0 for >1 minute.

marie: Also a sampleapp change: show a small toggle in demo UI that changes reservePct to visualize the tradeoff. Good for sales demos.

noah: Edgecase: what if prefetch already committed GPU work on the server and we cancel client-side? Might be wasted cost but better UX. Add an opt-in `prefetch.cancelOnPreempt=false` to control whether we send client abort or let server finish. Default true for demos.

ratebot: ratebot: created ticket RQ-2026-11 "client-side quota priorities: prefetch starvation"

izzy: I'll draft a PR with unit tests simulating concurrent user+prefetch traffic and a deterministic token-bucket clock. Will include docs.

marie: Thanks all. This should make our quickstart demo more robust and reduce support noise. :sparkles:
